## Summary

### Root Cause

In `src/strands/models/bedrock.py`, the `_format_request_message_content` method passed `toolUse["input"]` through to Bedrock's Converse API verbatim (line 1125). When a conversation is replayed and a tool-use block carries a non-dict `input` value (`None`, `""`, `[]`, an integer, etc.) — which can happen with no-argument tools — Bedrock rejects the request with a `ValidationException` because it requires `toolUse.input` to be a JSON object.

### Changes

**`src/strands/models/bedrock.py`** — `_format_request_message_content`, `toolUse` branch (lines 1120–1129):

```python
# Before
return {
    "toolUse": {
        "input": tool_use["input"],   # raw value, could be None / "" / [] …
        ...
    }
}

# After
raw_input = tool_use["input"]
normalized_input = raw_input if isinstance(raw_input, dict) else {}
return {
    "toolUse": {
        "input": normalized_input,    # always a dict
        ...
    }
}
```

The fix reads from the original dict but writes only to the new return value, so the caller's message is never mutated.

**`tests/strands/models/test_bedrock.py`** — three new test functions added after the existing `guardContent` tests:

| Test | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `test_format_request_message_content_normalizes_malformed_tool_use_input` | Parametrised over `None`, `""`, `"string"`, `[]`, `["a","b"]`, `42` — all must produce `input == {}` |
| `test_format_request_message_content_preserves_valid_dict_tool_use_input` | `{}`, `{"key":"value"}`, nested dict — all must pass through unchanged |
| `test_format_request_message_content_does_not_mutate_tool_use_input` | After `format_request`, the original message still has `input is None` |

### Verification

```
308 passed in 1.35s
```

All 308 tests in `tests/strands/models/test_bedrock.py` pass, including the 8 new regression tests.

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# toolUse.input normalisation – issue #4601
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "bad_input",
+    [
+        None,
+        "",
+        "some-string",
+        [],
+        ["a", "b"],
+        42,
+    ],
+    ids=["none", "empty_string", "string", "empty_list", "list", "int"],
+)
+def test_format_request_message_content_normalizes_malformed_tool_use_input(model, model_id, bad_input):
+    """Non-dict toolUse.input values must be replaced with {} before sending to Bedrock.
+
+    Bedrock rejects replayed history whose toolUse.input is None, an empty
+    string, a list, or any other non-object with a ValidationException.
+
+    See: https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/issues/4601
+    """
+    messages = [
+        {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "go"}]},
+        {
+            "role": "assistant",
+            "content": [
+                {
+                    "toolUse": {
+                        "toolUseId": "t1",
+                        "name": "no_args_tool",
+                        "input": bad_input,
+                    }
+                }
+            ],
+        },
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": [{"toolResult": {"toolUseId": "t1", "content": [{"text": "ok"}]}}],
+        },
+    ]
+
+    formatted_request = model.format_request(messages)
+
+    tool_use = formatted_request["messages"][1]["content"][0]["toolUse"]
+    assert tool_use["input"] == {}, (
+        f"Expected malformed input {bad_input!r} to be normalised to {{}}, got {tool_use['input']!r}"
+    )
+
+
+def test_format_request_message_content_preserves_valid_dict_tool_use_input(model, model_id):
+    """A dict toolUse.input (including empty {}) must pass through unchanged.
+
+    See: https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/issues/4601
+    """
+    for valid_input in [{}, {"key": "value"}, {"nested": {"a": 1}}]:
+        messages = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "go"}]},
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "toolUse": {
+                            "toolUseId": "t1",
+                            "name": "some_tool",
+                            "input": valid_input,
+                        }
+                    }
+                ],
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [{"toolResult": {"toolUseId": "t1", "content": [{"text": "ok"}]}}],
+            },
+        ]
+
+        formatted_request = model.format_request(messages)
+
+        tool_use = formatted_request["messages"][1]["content"][0]["toolUse"]
+        assert tool_use["input"] == valid_input, (
+            f"Valid dict input {valid_input!r} should not be modified, got {tool_use['input']!r}"
+        )
+
+
+def test_format_request_message_content_does_not_mutate_tool_use_input(model, model_id):
+    """Normalising a malformed toolUse.input must not modify the original message dict.
+
+    See: https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/issues/4601
+    """
+    original_bad_input = None
+    messages = [
+        {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "go"}]},
+        {
+            "role": "assistant",
+            "content": [
+                {
+                    "toolUse": {
+                        "toolUseId": "t1",
+                        "name": "no_args_tool",
+                        "input": original_bad_input,
+                    }
+                }
+            ],
+        },
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": [{"toolResult": {"toolUseId": "t1", "content": [{"text": "ok"}]}}],
+        },
+    ]
+
+    model.format_request(messages)
+
+    # The original message must be untouched
+    assert messages[1]["content"][0]["toolUse"]["input"] is None, (
+        "format_request must not mutate the original toolUse.input"
+    )
+
+
 def test_format_request_removes_status_field_when_configured(model, model_id):
